items.headline: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
items.summary: At a Google Cloud event, Google unveiled a unified Gemini agent that can carry out multi-step tasks across business apps, delegate work to subagents, call on multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity with an email address. It marks a significant push by Google to compete with OpenAI and Microsoft in enterprise agentic AI.

items.headline: OpenAI's revenue reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
items.summary: A new report says OpenAI told investors its real annualized revenue is roughly $20 billion below the ~$70 billion figure previously cited, and that its long-rumored IPO has been pushed back to early 2027. The news triggered a selloff in AI-linked stocks including Nvidia, AMD and Oracle.

items.headline: OpenAI's September annualized revenue nears $50 billion, below earlier estimates
items.summary: Reuters-sourced reporting says OpenAI told investors its September 2026 annualized revenue was about $50 billion, well under the roughly $70 billion figure circulated earlier, with the gap attributed partly to how revenue from cloud partners is accounted for. The revision adds to growing scrutiny of AI-sector valuations.

items.headline: Fired OpenAI researchers deny misconduct allegations, warn of impact on AI safety
items.summary: Two former OpenAI safety researchers who were dismissed for allegedly mishandling confidential information are disputing the company's account, saying the firings could discourage staff from raising safety concerns. OpenAI maintains an internal investigation found a 'pattern of misconduct' but has not detailed which policies were broken.

items.headline: AI bubble risks worst S&P 500 crash since 2008, strategist says
items.summary: Following the news of OpenAI's lower-than-expected revenue, a market strategist warned that the AI investment boom could unwind in a crash comparable to the 2008 financial crisis, underscoring mounting investor anxiety about stretched valuations across the AI sector.

items.headline: Cal AI's 19-year-old founder raises $10M for new personal AI agent startup
items.summary: Zach Yadegari, the teenage co-founder of calorie-tracking app Cal AI, has launched Persona, a personal AI agent startup built around a $179 wearable band, after raising a $10M round led by Vine Ventures with participation from Z Fellows and Collective Global.

items.headline: AI agent firm Instinct raises $1 billion in Series C funding
items.summary: Personal-agent startup Instinct, founded by 23-year-old Noah Shinn, raised a $1 billion Series C at a $10 billion valuation led by Sequoia, Benchmark and Coatue, roughly quadrupling its valuation in under a month. Its invite-only agent texts and calls on users' behalf to book, buy and cancel things, and has already crossed 100,000 users.

items.headline: Robotics startup FieldAI reportedly raising $700M at $10B valuation for 'robot brain' software
items.summary: FieldAI, which builds general-purpose AI software designed to work across different robot platforms and tasks, is reportedly closing in on a $700 million round at a $10 billion valuation — roughly five times its prior mark — with backing from existing investors including Bezos Expeditions and Nvidia's NVentures.

items.headline: Qualcomm acquires PickNik Robotics to advance open robotics and physical AI
items.summary: Qualcomm announced an agreement to acquire PickNik Robotics, the steward of the widely used open-source MoveIt manipulation framework, pledging to keep MoveIt open and community-driven while integrating it more closely with its Dragonwing robotics platforms.

items.headline: Biossil hits unicorn status with new OpenAI-led financing
items.summary: Toronto biotech startup Biossil, which uses an AI platform to identify and revive discontinued drug candidates, raised $153 million in a round led by the OpenAI Startup Fund, pushing its valuation to $1 billion and making it Canada's newest unicorn.
